parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 1 Wheat and 1 Wood for 1 Brick. My current hand is 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. I have a road leading to node 34, which is open. To build a settlement there, I need 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. If I accept this trade, I will have 2 Wheat, 1 Wood, and 2 Sheep, but I will lose my only Brick. Since the Brick 10 (Hex 13) is currently blocked by the robber and Brick is extremely scarce, giving up my only Brick now—even for two resources I need—prevents me from building the settlement immediately. However, I have no Wood production and my Wheat production is decent (Node 20 on Wheat 9). Jimmy is desperate, but this trade doesn't actually get me closer to building because I'd then be missing the Brick. I'll reject and try to hold the Brick for my own build or a better offer that includes Wood+Wheat while keeping my options open, though a 2:1 is tempting. Wait, looking at the board, Brick 10 is the only source and it's blocked. If I trade it, I might not get another one for a long time. I'll reject.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's 1 Wheat + 1 Wood for 1 Brick. While I need Wood and Wheat for node 34, giving up my only Brick when Hex 13 is blocked makes building impossible anyway. I need to find a way to get Wood and Wheat without losing the Brick.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, הצעה יפה, באמת. אבל מה זה עוזר לי לקבל עץ וחיטה אם אני נשארת בלי הטיט שצריך בשביל לבנות? הטיט הזה הוא היחיד שיש לי והעשירייה חסומה, אז אני נאלצת לסרב.
